memory-store-judge.instruction: Write ONLY the test file `store/mem_examples_test.go`: one `func TestMemoryStoreExample<n>(t *testing.T)` per example of `store/mem.go` taken from go.mod, in example order. Do not write or modify `store/mem.go`: the author of the criterion is not the author of the code. The test file is in package store; it imports the standard library, the module's `morphstudio/internal/testhelp` and `morphstudio/project` (to build project.Project values) only, and compares with `testhelp.Equal` (an error with `testhelp.Equal(t, what, err, ErrNotFound)`: the store returns the variables themselves). Go 1.22, gofmt-formatted.

file-store-judge.instruction: Write ONLY the test file `store/file_examples_test.go`: one `func TestFileStoreExample<n>(t *testing.T)` per example of `store/file.go` taken from go.mod, in example order. Do not write or modify `store/file.go` or `store/mem.go`: the author of the criterion is not the author of the code. The test file is in package store; it imports the standard library, the module's `morphstudio/internal/testhelp` and `morphstudio/project` only, and compares with `testhelp.Equal`. Every file a test touches lives under its own `t.TempDir()` (path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "projects.json")); list the directory with os.ReadDir to check that only projects.json is left. Go 1.22, gofmt-formatted.

basic-auth-judge.instruction: Write ONLY the test file `auth/basic_examples_test.go`: one `func TestBasicAuthExample<n>(t *testing.T)` per example of `auth/basic.go` taken from go.mod, in example order. Do not write or modify `auth/basic.go`: the author of the criterion is not the author of the code. The test file is in package auth; it imports the standard library (net/http, net/http/httptest) and the module's `morphstudio/internal/testhelp` only and compares with `testhelp.Equal`. HTTP only through `httptest.NewRequest` and `httptest.NewRecorder` (rec := httptest.NewRecorder(); h.ServeHTTP(rec, req); then rec.Code, rec.Header().Get(...), rec.Body.String()); never a listener. Go 1.22, gofmt-formatted.

router-judge.instruction: Write ONLY the test file `api/router_examples_test.go`: one `func TestRouterExample<n>(t *testing.T)` per example of `api/router.go` taken from go.mod, in example order. Do not write or modify `api/router.go` or any other file: the author of the criterion is not the author of the code. The test file is in package api; it imports the standard library, the module's `morphstudio/internal/testhelp`, `morphstudio/auth`, `morphstudio/project` and `morphstudio/store` only, and compares with `testhelp.Equal`. Never a listener: rec := httptest.NewRecorder(); r.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(method, target, strings.NewReader(body))) with the headers set on the request; the router fills the {id} path value itself. Go 1.22, gofmt-formatted.
